messages.author: 8db5509b17e1c2b8
messages.subject: Found more than one class "Model" in cache
parts:
When I start up R and run lavaan() for the first time in a new session, I often get this message:

>>Found more than one class "Model" in cache; using the first, from namespace 'lavaan'<<

Has anyone an idea what this means exactly, and is this an R or a lavaan thing?

lavaan (0.5-20)

Thanks,
Andrea

Terry

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Found more than one class "Model" in cache
parts:
The reason is simple: both lavaan and MatrixModels define a class
'Model'. The latter package only gets pulled in if you load semPlot.

Usually, this is harmless, as long as you see:

"Found more than one class "Model" in cache; using the first, from
namespace 'lavaan'"

As a rule, always load 'lavaan' first, and 'semPlot' later.

Yves.
